privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.subtitle: What data we collect, and how we use and protect it
privacy.intro: This policy explains what data the Aljoodi learning platform and its mobile application (app.aljoodi.ps) collect, and how that data is used and protected. By using the platform you agree to it.
privacy.contactText: For any question about your privacy, or to request the deletion of your account: info@aljoodi.ps — phone +972 56 742 9646

sections.title: 1. The data we collect
sections.text: Your account is created with your name, e-mail address and phone number: the data required to register, sign in, reset a password and contact you about your reservation. When you choose “Continue with Google” we receive only your name and e-mail from Google, and request no other permission on your account. The mobile application also stores the device notification identifier, so we can send alerts about your subjects.

sections.title: 2. What we do not collect
sections.text: We do not collect your location or your contacts, we do not read your phone's photo gallery, and we do not use your data for advertising.

sections.title: 3. How we use the data
sections.text: To run your account, to grant access to the subjects you subscribed to, to send alerts about those subjects, and to answer your support enquiries.

sections.title: 4. Sharing
sections.text: We do not sell your data and we do not share it with advertisers. Data is processed on our own servers, and Google is used for sign-in and notifications only, each within the limits described above.

sections.title: 5. Protecting the data
sections.text: All data travels between the application and our servers over an encrypted connection (HTTPS), and passwords are stored hashed so nobody can read them. Paid lessons are also protected against screenshots and screen recording inside the mobile application.

sections.title: 6. Retention and account deletion
sections.text: We keep your account data for as long as the account exists. You may request the deletion of your account and all of its data at any time by writing to info@aljoodi.ps from the address registered on the account; the request is carried out within 30 days at the latest.

sections.title: 7. Children's privacy
sections.text: The platform is aimed at students in the upper school grades, and we do not knowingly collect data from children under thirteen. Should we receive such data, we delete it once notified.

sections.title: 8. Changes to this policy
sections.text: We may update this policy, and the date of the last update appears at the top of the page. Material changes are announced inside the platform.
